name: mhud
description: Themed, dependency-free HUD & UI kit for game mods and live-stream overlays (NUI, OBS, HTML5): vitals, location, economy, equipment, vehicle, kill feed, gifts, broadcast crop, 4 themes.
author: Stream Ember Platform

scripts.site: npm run build && npm run ai && node tools/build-site.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run ai && node tools/build-site.mjs --local
scripts.version: node tools/set-version.mjs && npm run build && git add -A
